root_cause_label: Agent installed ML packages under /usr/local/bin/pip and trained under /usr/local/bin/python3, but the evaluation harness runs under /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python, creating an unresolved interpreter/package-scope mismatch that causes import failure at test time.
one_sentence_failure_summary: After observing a python/pip interpreter mismatch at step 6, the agent proceeded to install packages in /usr/local and later explicitly chose /usr/local/bin/python3 for training, while the evaluation harness uses /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python and cannot access the installed packages.
t_err_evidence: Step 7: Agent runs 'pip install ... torch transformers peft==0.15.0 ...' using /usr/local/bin/pip (the pip on PATH), which installs into /usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages. Step 6 had already revealed that the active 'python' is /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python while pip is /usr/local/bin/pip — a clear mismatch the agent did not resolve before installing.
t_commit_evidence: Step 18: Agent explicitly invokes '/usr/local/bin/python3 /app/train_lora.py', locking the training environment to /usr/local/bin/python3. All subsequent fixes and the successful training run proceed in this interpreter, permanently diverging from the /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python interpreter that the evaluation harness uses.
t_surface_evidence: Step 10: Running 'python /app/train_lora.py' (which resolves to /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python) fails with 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named torch', confirming that packages installed via /usr/local/bin/pip are not visible to the active interpreter.
trigger_explanation: Step 6 explicitly revealed that 'python' resolves to /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python while pip is /usr/local/bin/pip — a visible, documented mismatch. The LLM step analysis even noted this as critical. Despite this disconfirming evidence, the agent proceeded to install packages via /usr/local/bin/pip at step 7 without switching to the venv interpreter or using 'python -m pip', ignoring the signal.
forewarning_evidence: Step 6 terminal output: 'python' resolves to /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python, but 'which pip' returns /usr/local/bin/pip and pip shows 'python 3.13' from /usr/local/lib. This directly contradicts the assumption that pip and python share the same environment, yet the agent proceeded to use pip at step 7.
